en: A monochrome vintage view of a small cobblestoned village square with traditional multi‑story houses. In the center stands a large building with arched windows and balconies; on the right side is a building with shutters partly covered in climbing plants and signage identifying a restaurant. Overhead wires cross the sky. The printed caption at the top names the place and the restaurant.
